summary: Practise EVSE inspection, OCPP fault triage, and preventive maintenance planning. Review the course outline and outcomes.
lede: EV charger maintenance training prepares EVSE technicians, operations supervisors, and maintenance planners to inspect equipment, triage faults, and plan upkeep. You’ll practise checking charger enclosures, cables, and connectors; classifying OCPP fault records; scheduling preventive work; and documenting service actions. Exercises use sample records and checklists, with an introductory look at standards references and remote monitoring; the focus is maintenance, not installation design or advanced repair.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who inspect, support, or schedule the upkeep of EV charging equipment and need a consistent way to document condition, faults, and service priorities.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with EV charging equipment or electrical maintenance is recommended. You should understand basic electrical safety responsibilities in your workplace; the course does not teach electrical installation or authorize electrical testing. No coding or programming is required.
